visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a red bow dances energetically on a red stage in a baseball stadium. She wears a white and red cropped baseball jersey with 'Rakuten' branding and white shorts. To her left is a large red gorilla mascot, and to her right is a brown monkey mascot, both in baseball uniforms. (2) The woman performs a series of choreographed movements, including squatting, pointing, and waving, while maintaining a bright, smiling expression. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional stadium at night. (3) The scene shifts to a sequence of repetitive clips showing her jumping high while the monkey mascot remains stationary or moves sluggishly. Question marks and various Chinese text overlays appear on the screen to emphasize the mascot's lack of effort. (4) The camera alternates between wide shots of the three figures and close-ups of the woman's expressive face and fast hand gestures. A dense crowd is visible in the blurred background. (5) The woman finishes with a final pose, her arms raised in a V-shape, followed by a quick cut to a humorous shot of the mascot lying down on the ground.

(3) A 'Ding' sound effect occurs simultaneously with a question mark graphic on screen. The female singing continues with high arousal and a bright tone.
